b:
Learn
to love
even those
who hate you

I loved,
and grew to hate

I spread out
the carpet
like a red lotus

Your frown,
as if at mud,
shows
even through
the veil on your face

Are you worthy
of my
love?

Like water
on a lotus leaf:
what name is there
for this relationship?

My heart
knows the answer
and pretends
not to

Though time
announced it to me,
I shut my ears

Now
I cannot blindfold
my eyes as well

Loose flowers,
say
what you
feel

Like the bird that leaves the dried pond,
break off
and go

Because
I do not know
how to handle
scissors
note: Water on a lotus leaf never soaks in: a Tamil image for a relationship without real attachment. The bird that leaves a drying pond comes from Avvaiyar's Moothurai: those who leave you when times are bad are not true kin.
